title: Less waiting. More campus life.
lines: Meet Theeska Poo.
Campus printing, with a little less waiting, and a lot more freedom.

title: Your campus. Your account.
lines: Start with your verified college email.
One account takes you straight to your student workspace.

title: Pages counted. Automatically.
lines: Add your PDF or supported image.
Theeska Poo counts the pages automatically, so you don't have to.

title: Your print. Your way.
lines: Choose copies, colour, and print settings.
Your fixed total updates as you go.
Twelve black and white pages? Sixty rupees.

title: Place it. Pay your way.
lines: Place your order.
Scan the QR, open a supported UPI app on your phone, or pay at collection.
Online payments are confirmed by the recipient.

title: A place for every print.
lines: Every order gets a dated collection code: an hourly slot, plus a number.
Assigned from order time, it helps the shop organise your prints.

title: The counter, under control.
lines: Behind the counter, operators see documents, settings, and payments together.
They can pause new orders when busy, then mark completed prints ready to collect.

title: Ready. Set. Collect.
lines: See Ready to collect? Head to the shop with your code.
After handover, the order moves to history.

title: PRINT. PICK UP. POOO!
lines: Upload. Print. Pick up. Theeska Poo.
Built for campus life, by Tech Titans.
